Name: TRON Light Cycle Tractors
Author: mattattack498
Description:
[b][u][size=5]Stardew Valley - TRON Light Cycle Tractors[/size][/u][/b]

Replaces the default tractor mod asset with a Tron Light Cycle. Seasonal Light Cycles available.

Created by MattAttack!

[b]Matt's Twitter[/b]: https://twitter.com/MatthewRysz

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yC0jI2j.png[/img]
[u]
[b][size=4]REQUIREMENTS
[/size][/b][/u]
[b][size=3]1. SMAPI[/size][/b]
https://smapi.io/

[b][size=4]2. Tractor Mod[/size][/b]
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401

[b][u][size=4]INSTALLATION
[/size][/u][/b]
To install, just drag the images into the tractor mod's assets folder.

[b][u][size=4]NOTES
[/size][/u][/b]
The Light Cycle lights will change to match each season. If you would like to only use the default color (blue) then only replace the tractor.png in the assets folder.

The light colors for each season are:

[b]SPRING: [/b]Purple
[b]SUMMER: [/b]Blue
[b]FALL: [/b]Orange
[b]WINTER: [/b]White
